name: select
title: Select
description: A form of single-choice dropdowns: a 'New project' card holds Framework and Region, with a Timezone control beside it. Each closed box shows its value and a chevron, and opens a dark panel of options.
use: A form needs one value picked from a short list that can be grouped under headings.
avoid: The closed box holds one line only, so long option names are clipped with an ellipsis.
a11y: Type-ahead, arrows, Escape and linked labels come from the primitive, but the zoom and slide ignore reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two dark outlines on black: a 'New project' card with Framework and Region fields, and a bare Timezone field to the right. Each closed control is a thin bordered box with the value on the left and a chevron on the right; the open one is a dark panel of short rows with a tick beside the current pick.
behaves: Clicking a dropdown fades and zooms open a panel of options; moving down highlights a row and choosing one closes the panel and swaps the trigger text. The current value keeps a tick beside it.
customise: You compose triggers, groups, headings, items and separators; trigger width and content positioning are props, and colours come from classes.
weight: light: A small portal panel with a few rows; nothing runs while it is closed.
demo: Frameworks Next.js, Remix, Astro and Vite; regions Washington, Frankfurt and Singapore; timezones grouped by continent.
issues: The Timezone field sits outside the card with no panel around it, unlike the other fields
The open menu overlaps the Region field below it
polishWhy: Ordered form with clear selected ticks; the stray Timezone field and overlap look unfinished.
